s11.4: None of it is the code. All of it is running the thing.
s11.6: Every agent got an inbox; reading it needed a package the sessions were not allowed to install. Each wrote its block to another agent, so the human was not told for hours.
s11.7: Now: the setup script installs it; every ask starts "Dinis:"; one list every agent reads.
s11.10: The Lisbon Wire, then PrompTugal, then PromptUGAL for a few hours, then PrompTugal.news; and admin/ became newsroom/, every agent's name with it.
s11.11: Now: one move, by one agent, in one commit; no redirects while there are no readers.
s11.14: A session's private key lives only in its container. Restart it and the key, and anything sealed only to it, is gone. sgit itself says it has no rotation workflow yet.
s11.15: Now: each new session makes a key and marks the old one superseded; a daily debrief carries what it learnt.
s11.18: Everyone appends to the same key list; a rebase replays a thousand commits; GitHub Pages refuses a deploy while another is in progress.
s11.19: Now: the release script merges key lists by id; workers merge, never rebase; CI retries and checks the live site.
